<description>
Originally, legacy wallet migration was built upon the foundation of being able to load legacy wallets. Now that we no longer support loading legacy wallets, there is no reason to keep any of the legacy wallet loading and migration code in the main wallet objects. Having this co-mingling of never-to-be-changed legacy wallet code and new descriptor wallet code makes it difficult to implement new things into the wallet.

This PR fully separates out all of the legacy wallet related things into a subdirectory `wallet/legacy`, with everything in that directory under a `wallet::legacy_migration` namespace so as to prevent accidental usage outside of legacy wallets. This includes a little bit of duplication with current loading code, but not that much, and we are able to both remove unrelated descriptor wallet loading from the legacy wallet loading, and unrelated legacy wallet loading from normal descriptor wallet loading.

`LegacyWallet` is introduced as a subclass of `CWallet` which contains all of the relevant legacy wallet and migration functions so that `CWallet` cannot accidentally use some legacy wallet function. Additionally, `LegacyDataSPKM` is moved into a new file and this new namespace so that it cannot be used outside of migration.

Lastly, `ReorderTransactions` is a legacy wallet only function that is also moved into `LegacyWallet`.

Builds upon #34909, and depends on #36823 for removing some functions that were previously used by migration.
</description>

The wallet/migrate.h|cpp file contain all the code related to the

This patch renames the file to legacybdb so that the intent is clearer in the
call sites. I felt this rename might be necessary so that the name
doesn't conflict with the new migration.cpp introduced in the preceding commits.

40631b84ca wallet: Skip copy of legacy wallet records rather than erasing

Instead of erasing legacy wallet records and tx records from the
migrated database, skip copying these records in the first place.

ed9eff6efd wallet: Remove unused RemoveTxs and EraseTx

a5c507c87a wallet, walletdb: Remove unused DeleteRecordsWithDB and EraseRecords

be7ddb4660 walletdb: Make HasLegacyRecords static

HasLegacyRecords is only used by LoadLegacyWalletRecords to check
whether a descriptor wallet has any legacy wallet records. This does not
require a CWallet, and is no longer called by anything outside of
walletdb.cpp.

755ab9b3ce wallet, migration: Move migration specific things to legacy subdir

5b6ead13c9 wallet, migration: Put all migration related code into a namespace

Put all legacy wallet migration related code into a custom namespace to
clearly delineate which functions are migration and which are not, and
to prevent accidentally calling into migration functions from outside of
migration.

ec58b5d6c8 wallet, migration: Use a slimmed down wallet loading function

Instead of calling CWallet::LoadExisting, use a custom loading function
for migration only that does fewer things. This will be used in later
commits to implement a custom, migration specific, loading flow.

5f3c370149 wallet, migration: Move legacy wallet loading code to migration module

f7eeec88e2 wallet, migration: Add a LegacyWallet subclass of CWallet

LegacyWallet owns all of the wallet migration functions so that they do
not need to live in CWallet anymore.

bb7c84a7ba wallet, migration: Move LegacyDataSPKM to its own file within migration

59fd47320f wallet, migration: Move ReorderTransactions to LegacyWallet

Reordering transactions is something that only legacy wallets will need
to do. All newly created descriptor wallets will have transactions with
order information. Migrated descriptor wallets will have computed the
order information during migration, and the updated tx records are
written to the new wallet, so always contain the order information.
